PRIDE organisms NEWT:562 Escherichia coli; OLS NCBITaxon:562

limitations: Paper full text not available (closed access; Europe PMC/Unpaywall closed, ACS 403); abstract only.
H10407 inferred from file stem H104 plus PRIDE keyword and deposited FASTA name.
H608 is the depositor label (aliases: MaxQuant HA608, raw acquisition name VK_608L/VK_608T); no public strain record or FASTA found; official designation, lineage and serotype unknown.
H104_L2/H104_T2 carry internal acquisition names LH104_1/TH104_1; deposited name and MaxQuant experiment H104-2 used.
comment[cleavage agent details] filled per run by a diff-verified post-build script (scratchpad/PXD005259/fill_cleavage.py) because build sets one value per sample row.
reconcile reports lexical cleavage-agent findings for the /P term names; the /P variants are the deposited search settings.
Per-strain lineage and colonization-factor profile not annotated (paper unreadable).
Reduction/alkylation reagents not stated in readable record; columns omitted.
comment[collision energy] and comment[lc batch] derived from raw-header method and folder names.
